children.name: Fouquieria burragei Rose
children.description: Fouquieria burragei, known commonly as the gulf ocotillo or pichilingue, is a species of perennial plant in the genus Fouquieria (referred to as ocotillos), native to the gulf coast of Baja California Sur.

children.name: Fouquieria columnaris Kellogg ex Curran
children.description: Fouquieria columnaris, the Boojum tree or cirio ( ) is a tree in the ocotillo family, whose other members include the ocotillos.

children.name: Fouquieria diguetii  I.M.Johnst.
children.description: Fouquieria diguetii, known by the common names Adam's tree, palo Adán, and Baja [California] tree ocotillo, is a plant in the family Fouquieriaceae native to the southern half of the Baja California Peninsula, and the coasts of Sonora and Sinaloa.

children.name: Fouquieria fasciculata  Nash
children.description: Fouquieria fasciculata is a species of desert flowering plant in the family Fouquieriaceae.

children.name: Fouquieria formosa Kunth
children.description: Fouquieria formosa is a species of perennial plant in the genus Fouquieria, known by the vernacular names palo santo, rabo de iguana, rosalillo, tlapacon, corona de Cristo and flor de jabon.

children.name: Fouquieria leonilae Miranda
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (C. Guerrero). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Fouquieria macdougalii Nash
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Sonora, Sinaloa, W. Chihuahua). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Fouquieria ochoterenae Miranda
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (SW. Puebla, NW. Oaxaca). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Fouquieria purpusii Brandegee
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (S. Puebla, N. Oaxaca). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Fouquieria shrevei I.M.Johnst.
children.description: Fouquieria shrevei is a plant species native to the States of Coahuila and Durango states of northeastern Mexico.
